notes: Window: all cited facts dated on or before D (2026-10-02). Anthropic report Sept 30, 2026; IFR Sept 24 and Sept 30, 2026; DigitalToday 2026-10-01 15:16 KST; MIXED dated Oct 2, 2026 (same day as D, not after; its facts duplicate the Sept 30 Anthropic report, which is co-cited). O*NET overview shows 'Site updated October 6, 2026' but the cited facts (DOL sponsorship, 900+ occupations, 19,000+ tasks) are long-standing.

Background: the only dated item older than the 45-day window is the March 5, 2026 Anthropic labor-market report in Further reading, labelled 'Background from March'. 1977 backtest figures are the Sept 30 report's own findings.
No 'ahead' block; 'What to watch' section relies only on figures published by Sept 30 (Anthropic, IFR).

Quotes all 14 words or fewer and attributed: 'can replace 74 percent of manual labor' (headline), 'mostly in limited settings', O*NET task line (10 words), 'Dig trenches', 'Teach dance students', 'difficult to predict exactly', 'requires many judgment calls'.

Minor precision notes (not errors): E0 26% is 100 minus 74; the page text says 'about a quarter'. E1 50% is the page's 'half'. The 'highly exposed workers' comparison on the page is top-quintile vs unexposed workers. IFR 117,500 is from the release body; its subheading says 117,000. The report's own $49,000 vs $45,000 figures differ by $4,000 while it states ~$2,500; the draft correctly reports the page's $2,500.
Final paragraph of sections[4] (no src) is general advice with no checkable factual claim; not counted.
Fetch method: pages opened with WebFetch on 2026-10-24 (direct curl blocked by proxy); passages are as returned by WebFetch.
